args.description: Seamless flat worn marine mosaic/sandstone combat platform texture, frontal side-view top surface filling the whole rectangular canvas. Broad muted desaturated grey-green stone slabs, dark seams, few shell fragments only near corners. Flat horizontal footing, no raised objects, stairs, black void, plants, borders or large perspective grid. Calm low contrast. Match Dungeon Matcher crisp native pixel-art: no anti-aliasing, gradients, blur or noisy individual speckles. Top-left light.
